name: Nevin Stanton-Trehan
office: City of South Pasadena, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Nevin Stanton-Trehan is chair of the South Pasadena Finance Commission and a candidate for City Council in District 4. He is the chief people officer and general counsel at the YMCA of Metropolitan Los Angeles. He serves on the South Pasadena Education Foundation board. He supports the $80 million bond measure on the November ballot to repair streets. As general counsel, he says he has settled more than 15 litigation matters.
